paper.title_en: Modular Krylov Complexity as a Boundary Probe of Area Operators and Entanglement Islands
paper.abstract_en: We show that the area operator of a quantum extremal surface can be reconstructed directly from boundary dynamics without reference to bulk geometry. Our approach combines the operator-algebra quantum error-correction (OAQEC) structure of AdS/CFT with modular Krylov complexity. Using Lanczos coefficients of boundary modular dynamics, we extract the spectrum of the modular Hamiltonian restricted to the algebra of the entanglement wedge and isolate its central contribution, which is identified with the area operator. The construction is purely boundary-based and applies to superpositions of semiclassical geometries as well. As a prospective application, we discuss island formation and the Page transition in evaporating black holes using boundary modular evolution, bypassing any bulk extremization. More broadly, our results establish modular Krylov complexity as a probe of emergent spacetime geometry, providing a new route to accessing black hole interiors from boundary quantum dynamics.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文将模Krylov复杂度与AdS/CFT的算子代数量子纠错结构结合，提出从边界动力学直接重构量子极值面的面积算符，并讨论蒸发黑洞中的岛屿形成与Page转变。该构造具有明确的理论框架与可检验的推广方向，理论深度高，与黑洞热力学及全息主题高度相关，值得点击阅读全文以评估其推导细节与适用性。
decision.title_zh: 作为面积算符与纠缠岛的边界探针的模Krylov复杂度
decision.abstract_zh: 我们证明，量子极值面的面积算符可以直接从边界动力学重构，而无需参照体几何。我们的方法将AdS/CFT的算子代数量子纠错（OAQEC）结构与模Krylov复杂度相结合。利用边界模动力学的Lanczos系数，我们提取限制在纠缠楔代数上的模哈密顿量的谱，并分离出其中心贡献，该贡献被认定为面积算符。该构造完全基于边界，并且也适用于半经典几何的叠加态。作为一个前瞻性应用，我们讨论蒸发黑洞中的岛屿形成与Page转变，使用边界模演化，绕过任何体极值化。更广泛地说，我们的结果确立了模Krylov复杂度作为涌现时空几何的探针，为从边界量子动力学访问黑洞内部提供了新途径。
